chunks.heading: Following The Sheep
chunks.notes: Sets up Shaun's job search and driven routine with no horror elements yet, purely establishing situation.

chunks.heading: Following The Sheep
chunks.notes: Shaun mentally shelves a stack of discrete wrongnesses (the number, the emblem, the hissing speakers, the blood sample) while reassuring himself, the classic catalogued-escalation-with-denial pattern.

chunks.heading: Following The Sheep
chunks.notes: The self-operating elevator, unexplained intruding voice, and independently-opening dungeon-like doors escalate the wrongness while Shaun's own agency and perception grow unreliable.

chunks.heading: Following The Sheep
chunks.notes: The dark figure names his demonic allegiance and Shaun, his motor control already surrendered, nods and reaches to sign a document he cannot read.

chunks.heading: Following The Sheep
chunks.notes: Shaun's finger is cut and his blood forced onto the document against his will, and the closing line confirms his transformation into a servant of the devil, a non-rescued ending.
